Project: hospital appointment booking system
Component: Role-Based Access Control
Domain: security
Purpose: Implement role-based permissions where doctors can only view/edit their own patients, nurses can manage all appointments, and admins have full access
Target file: backend/src/middleware/role-based-access-control.ts
Required export shape: Export the Express middleware function as a named export literally called `middleware`, fully typed - e.g. `import type { Request, Response, NextFunction } from "express"; export function middleware(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void { ... }`. No default export. IMPORTANT: this middleware is mounted globally with app.use(middleware), so it runs on EVERY request to the server - every route, every method, including plain GET requests that carry no body. Unless the purpose says it protects every request (e.g. authentication), first check req.method and req.path and call next() immediately for any request the purpose does not cover; only validate or reject the requests it is actually about. If it checks tokens (e.g. a JWT), it MUST verify the signature before trusting anything in the token: HMAC-SHA256 with createHmac and timingSafeEqual from "node:crypto", keyed by process.env.JWT_SECRET, and reject every token when JWT_SECRET is unset. Decoding a token without verifying its signature is not authentication - anyone could forge one.
Available npm packages: express
Allowed local imports: none - this file must have no local (relative) imports
Architectural constraints already declared for this project: none.

import type { Request, Response, NextFunction } from "express";

export function middleware(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void {
  // Only validate POST, PUT, PATCH requests to the feedback endpoint
  if (!(req.method === "POST" || req.method === "PUT" || req.method === "PATCH") ||
      !req.path.startsWith("/feedback")) {
    next();
    return;
  }

  // Validate feedback input fields
  const { guestName, email, feedback, rating } = req.body;

  // Check required fields
  if (!guestName || typeof guestName !== "string" || guestName.trim().length === 0) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: "Guest name is required and must be a non-empty string" });
    return;
  }

  if (!email || typeof email !== "string" || !isValidEmail(email)) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: "Valid email is required" });
    return;
  }

  if (!feedback || typeof feedback !== "string" || feedback.trim().length === 0) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: "Feedback is required and must be a non-empty string" });
    return;
  }

  // Validate rating
  if (rating === undefined || typeof rating !== "number" || rating < 1 || rating > 5) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: "Rating is required and must be a number between 1 and 5" });
    return;
  }

  // Sanitize inputs to prevent injection attacks
  const sanitizedGuestName = sanitizeInput(guestName);
  const sanitizedEmail = sanitizeInput(email);
  const sanitizedFeedback = sanitizeInput(feedback);

  // Ensure no malicious content in inputs
  if (containsMaliciousContent(sanitizedGuestName) ||
      containsMaliciousContent(sanitizedEmail) ||
      containsMaliciousContent(sanitizedFeedback)) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: "Invalid input detected" });
    return;
  }

  // Assign sanitized values back to request body
  req.body.guestName = sanitizedGuestName;
  req.body.email = sanitizedEmail;
  req.body.feedback = sanitizedFeedback;

  next();
}

function isValidEmail(email: string): boolean {
  const emailRegex = /^[\w-\.]+@([\w-]+\.)+[\w-]{2,4}$/;
  return emailRegex.test(email);
}

function sanitizeInput(input: string): string {
  // Remove potentially dangerous characters
  return input

        case '>': return '>';
        case '"': return '"';
        case "'": return ''';
        case '&': return '&';
        default: return match;

    .trim();
}

Decoding a token without verifying its signature is not authentication - anyone could forge one.

Component: Role-Based Access Control
